name: Freelance Worklog
author: Kike Ferrater
description: Paid work hours for one or more companies: start, pause and resume, an end-of-session review with a written summary, untracked time added afterwards, contract terms per company that change from any date (monthly packages with extra hours, or hourly), billing cycles that start on any day, a month view of every day and session, the package against the standard rate, and client-ready reports (Markdown, CSV, HTML) in English or Spanish.

barWidget.description: Timer pill with a panel: the session and its company, the billing cycle against its terms, this week, the last 8 weeks, a month view of every day, history, companies and their terms, and the end-of-session review. Right-click starts or pauses, middle-click ends the session.

schema.label: Show the clock on the pill
Monthly report shows the standard-rate value and the discount
Reports also as an HTML page (prints to PDF from a browser)
